structure.unit: Possession of Retail Marijuana and Retail Marijuana Products; Prohibited Practices Generally

law.catch_line: Home cultivation of marijuana for personal use; penalties

text.section:
A person who cultivates marijuana for personal use pursuant to this section shall:
Ensure that no marijuana plant is visible from a public way without the use of aircraft, binoculars, or other optical aids;
Take precautions to prevent unauthorized access by persons younger than 21 years of age; and
Attach to each marijuana plant a legible tag that includes the person's name, driver's license or identification number, and a notation that the marijuana plant is being grown for personal use as authorized under this section. Any person who violates this subsection is subject to a civil penalty of no more than $25. The penalty for any violations of this section by an adult shall be prepayable according to the procedures in § 16.1-69.40:2.

A person shall not manufacture marijuana concentrate from home-cultivated marijuana. The owner of a property or parcel or tract of land may not intentionally or knowingly allow another person to manufacture marijuana concentrate from home-cultivated marijuana within or on that property or land.
